title: Exploring the Underwater World Segmentation without Extra Training
abstract: arXiv:2511.07923v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate segmentation of marine organisms is vital for biodiversity monitoring and ecological assessment, yet existing datasets and models remain largely limited to terrestrial scenes. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{AquaOV255}, the first large-scale and fine-grained underwater segmentation dataset containing 255 categories and over 20K images, covering diverse categories for open-vocabulary (OV) evaluation. Furthermore, we establish the first underwater OV segmentation benchmark, \textbf{UOVSBench}, by integrating AquaOV255 with five additional underwater datasets to enable comprehensive evaluation. Alongside, we present \textbf{Earth2Ocean}, a training-free OV segmentation framework that transfers terrestrial vision--language models (VLMs) to underwater domains without any additional underwater training. translated_title: 无需额外训练的水下世界分割探索
translated_abstract: 海洋生物的精确分割对生物多样性监测和生态评估至关重要，然而现有的数据集和模型在很大程度上仍局限于陆地场景。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了AquaOV255——首个大规模、细粒度的水下分割数据集，包含255个类别和超过2万张图像，涵盖用于开放词汇（OV）评估的多样化类别。此外，我们通过将AquaOV255与其他五个水下数据集相结合，建立了首个水下开放词汇分割基准UOVSBench，以实现全面的评估。同时，我们提出了Earth2Ocean，这是一个免训练的开放词汇分割框架，能够将陆地视觉-语言模型（VLM）迁移到水下领域，而无需任何额外的水下训练。Earth2Ocean包含两个核心组件：几何引导的视觉掩码生成器（GMG），其通过对……进行细化（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文贡献了首个大规模细粒度水下开放词汇分割数据集AquaOV255及基准UOVSBench，并提出免训练框架Earth2Ocean，无需额外训练即可将陆地视觉-语言模型迁移至水下分割任务。
